test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days. In how many days 9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days.

**Concept Used:**

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12M × 8 = 4B × 40

⇒ 3M = 5B

⇒ M : B = 5 : 3

Total work = 12 × 5 × 8 = 480

9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work in = 480/(9 × 3 + 3 × 5)

⇒ 480/42

⇒ 80/7 days

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
